scope: run live-oidc-port-repair, final ~60 s of MULTIPLE readiness (27 sequential attempts); private /proc counters only, numeric, role names only
method: per-PID utime+stime deltas from /proc/<pid>/stat at 1 s cadence for this checkout's service processes; system busy from /proc/stat
limits: rchar counts read-syscall input served from page cache; attributing it to the mandated fresh image reads is a source-based inference, not a per-call measurement
CPU seconds are not per-request costs and do not identify individual awaits, locks or the expiring stage
the host was shared with other agent workloads (mean 1-minute load 7.8 on 14 CPUs, about 50% busy), so absolute values are environment-dependent
